newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish police find 90,000 litres of smuggled spiri.
newsitem.headline: Polish police find 90,000 litres of smuggled spiri.

text.p: Polish police discovered nearly 90,000 litres of pure spirit smuggled in from Germany -- the single largest alcohol shipment bust in Poland, PAP news agency said on Saturday.

Pawel Biedziak, police spokesman in the North-western border city of Szczecin told PAP that the 98-percent pure alcohol, which was produced in Western Europe, had a market value of five million zlotys ($1.5 million). ($ = 3.244 Polish Zlotys)
